title: A turn the model has not answered yet shows one Thinking row

turns.prompt: Think it through first: what is the sum of the first ten positive integers? Reply with just the number.

invariant: Captured on staging 2026-10-05 (Claude Sonnet 5.5 via Pi, effort max): the assistant message arrives with no parts and the first reasoning delta follows seconds later. In that gap the turn shows exactly one Thinking row — one shimmering label, no stacked copies — and the row leaves when the reasoning starts.
